faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for BTSC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) for filling up technical positions across the state government sector.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under Advt No 30/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for the Scientific Assistant post under Advertisement Number 30/2026 by the commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online for BTSC Scientific Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 25-09-2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their forms through the web portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must ensure that they submit their completed online application forms on or before the closing date of 24-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree in Science (Chemistry) or B.Pharm along with 1 year of experience in testing and analysis of drugs.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for BTSC Scientific Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, while the maximum age ranges from 37 to 42 years depending upon the candidate's category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to General, OBC, and Other State categories are required to pay an application fee amounting to Rs. 100.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive their compensation according to Pay Level-5 as per the guidelines of the Bihar Technical Service Commission.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Competitive Examination conducted as a Computer Based Test followed by weightage for relevant experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for the BTSC Scientific Assistant job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of the commission at www.btsc.bihar.gov.in before the deadline.
